description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of different models, including RoBERTa and various LaSQuE configurations. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, with labels corresponding to the models: RoBERTa w/o Exp., LaSQuE (mean), LaSQuE, LaSQuE (syn2real), and LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum). The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 40% to 65% with a linear scale and tick labels at 5% intervals. Each model is represented by a distinct colored bar: RoBERTa w/o Exp. is gray, LaSQuE (mean) is orange, LaSQuE is green, LaSQuE (syn2real) is purple, and LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum) is black. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and their heights correspond to the accuracy percentages, with values of approximately 46%, 47%, 55%, 47%, 59%, and 62% for the respective models. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and none are visually emphasized. The chart directly compares the accuracy of the different models, with the tallest bar representing LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum) at around 62% and the shortest bars being RoBERTa w/o Exp. and LaSQuE at approximately 46% and 47%, respectively.
